body:
Stress-driven nucleus replacement could introduce a configured forbidden vowel/coda pair after legal coda selection. This change applies the same configured pair predicate to original coda selection and both existing nucleus replacement pools, preserves the coda and relative weights, and checks all nucleus/coda segments before root spelling. Empty or nonfinite repair pools fail before selection RNG; untouched nuclei retain their existing behavior.

This is Q10b1, with explicit Q07 (#314) + draft Q11 (#313) dependencies. Review the incremental change against dependency-only commit `13c2524dccabd58d37f5a8ec675eeffe1181df95`. Q10a (#320), new exclusions, weight tuning, broader stress repair, and final surface/morphological legality are outside this change.

## Measured result

The frozen 200,000-word development control has 22 configured pair violations across 327,029 prepared-root nucleus×coda slots; the candidate has 0 across 326,957. Candidate results by profile are 5→0 / 10→0 / 0→0 / 7→0. All 19,300 changed stress repairs have structured, detached events matched bijectively to stage differences. 164 repairs exclude 328 positive candidates. There are no observed edge repairs; that path is exercised by focused fixtures. All 50,000 monosyllable raw outputs are byte-identical to control.

All raw artifacts and exact source sets are verified. An independent Python implementation checks 600,000 archived draws across original/control/candidate, including layer denominators, repair counts and witness equality. A separate 20,000-word replay with pair exclusions cleared identically matches complete outputs, RNG calls and next RNG values.

Broader diagnostics are mixed: unique spellings change by −10/−22/0/−9; trigram JSD changes by +0.000201/−0.000528/0/+0.0000667 bits against control. Lexicon-bare open-final checked-vowel observations increase 1,260→1,277. Full counts, eligibility changes and original-baseline comparisons are retained. The code, fixtures and fixed sample support this scoped implementation correction; it does not establish improved human wordlikeness or validate each configured exclusion linguistically.

The earlier Q11 dependency remains a draft with an `ugh` gate failure in its recorded history. This run passes the unchanged gate (`ugh` ratio 0.0110 against floor 0.0062), but Q10b1 does not claim to repair that gate. The separate unchanged-generator study (#321) observed `ugh` failures in 12 of 20 predefined streams; no gate threshold is changed here.

## Validation and review paths

- 453 unit tests pass, one existing skip; 12 unchanged quality checks pass.
- 21 focused contract fixtures and 19 observer/archive fixtures pass; strict types/lint pass.
- Isolated performance: 6,101 words/sec (floor 4,500), 1.40× median batch variance (limit 3.0×).
- Runtime frozen source digest: `c6c6e85c0664ae237cd4df38b3b1d485d9b1b55658456d11b1920e557f10ac1f`; preregistered observer: `a236febc098e021cea0a29209b0fce379cc3dc5091a618007ed1622f1bcb3a21`.

Start with `docs/root-rime-compatibility.md`, then `src/core/rime-compatibility.ts`, the two replacement pools, and `src/core/rime-compatibility.test.ts`. Full compressed reports, compact capture files, source freezes and all mixed diagnostics are in `evaluation/experiments/root-rime-compatibility/`. The probe requires the frozen #307 evaluator; copied top-level tooling and raw words are not committed.

The PR targets the published dependency-control branch so its diff contains only Q10b1. Repository CI is filtered to PRs against `main`, so this stacked PR has no automatic CI checks yet; the validation above was run locally on the frozen candidate. Retarget after the reviewed prerequisites reach `main`.
